notes.title: The demo version of Machine Mind is now available!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/1a8949e6aa6f0c783b4723eea86b8daa82b41532.jpg

Become one of the first explorers of the wastelands and start your exciting journey in a ruined world!

In this demo version, you will have the opportunity to explore the starting biome, build and develop your base, as well as fend off raiders and battle the first boss in the game.

Share your impressions and don’t forget to add Machine Mind to your wishlist!

notes.title: The demo version of Machine Mind will be available on February 20th!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451682/1616e31dd3f6da695fcb40c3e20a8595ca85706e.png

We are happy to announce that the game demo will soon be available to everyone – an exciting adventure in the wastelands of a shattered world will begin on February 20th!

Add Machine Mind to your wishlist and follow our social media to stay updated on the latest news:
